LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 7.3.1 TENSE: FUTURE TIME USING WILL/SHALL

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.3: Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Tense: Future Time using will/shall

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Tense: Future Time using will/shall. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify words that indicate future time using will and shall in sentences
2. use will and shall to express future time correctly

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GRAMMAR IN USE 7.3.1 TENSE: FUTURE TIME USING WILL/SHALL
Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Tense: Future Time using will/shall is a Grade mathematics skill used at school, at the market, and at home.

HOW TO STUDY THIS TOPIC
1. Read each idea slowly.
2. Copy every worked example into your book and recalculate it yourself.
3. Then try the practice questions without looking at the answers.

WORKED EXAMPLE STYLE
Write the question clearly. Show each step. Box the final answer.
Example framework:
  Question: (write a Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Tense: Future Time using will/shall problem)
  Step 1: …
  Step 2: …
  Answer: …

KENYAN CONTEXT
Use shillings, market goods, school desks, or garden plots as story numbers so the maths feels real.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Solve one simple Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Tense: Future Time using will/shall question using objects or a drawing.

Example 2: Solve a harder Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Tense: Future Time using will/shall question showing every step.

Example 3: Make a word problem about Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Tense: Future Time using will/shall set at a Kenyan market.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write and solve five questions on Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Tense: Future Time using will/shall.
2. Explain one solution aloud to a parent or friend.
3. Invent one new word problem and solve it.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Complete 10 practice questions on Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Tense: Future Time using will/shall in your exercise book.
2. Mark your work. Redo any question you missed.
3. Teach a younger learner one method from this lesson.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify words that indicate future time using will and shall in sentences
2. use will and shall to express future time correctly

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
